sloka: फलानि अमृत गन्धीनि मूलानि कुसुमानि च ।बुभुजुर् वानरास् तत्र पादपानाम् बल उत्कटाः ॥६-४-९०॥।।
transliteration: phalāni amṛta gandhīni mūlāni kusumāni ca ।bubhujur vānarās tatra pādapānām bala utkaṭāḥ ॥6-4-90॥।।

translations.english: Then the vanaras who were deluded with pride climbed the trees and ate the fruits with nectar like aroma, roots and flowers.
